name: Comment prompt: lower-left button
when: The voice asks the viewers a question and says to answer in the comments. Put it on a calm, good-looking shot; it doesn't stop the video. subscribe-B's sibling: same corner, same press.
anchor: The question unrolls from the left edge when the voice starts asking it (`at`); the button press (`press`) lands on the word "comments".

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.question: the question as the voice asks it, sentence case, 46 characters at most (one line)
vars.done: button text after the press, after a drawn down arrow; default Down below
vars.avatar: the profile picture file from the channel kit, copied into the project's assets/; empty = no circle at all (no initials, no placeholder)
vars.at: seconds after the start: when the voice starts the question (normally 0)
vars.press: seconds after the start: when the voice says "comments" (at least 1.1)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.4 s later)

changed: subscribe-B with the question in the channel name's place (no channel name: the question is the text). The button says Comment and rolls to a drawn down arrow + Down below; it widens past 252 px when a label needs it. The glass edge after the press is full white (was 70 %). The dim reaches past the row's end.
